premise: Rabbit wakes up flat and bounceless; Frog tries jumping for him and Bee tries buzzing him up; in the end they just sit with him and hum, and his hop comes back on its own.
inspiration: Andersen's kindness tales, turned: slow days are allowed, nobody is fixed by force, and friends who simply stay are the cure.
lesson: Some days are flat, and friends who sit with you help most.

en-US.title: Rabbit Loses His Bounce
en-US.text: One morning Rabbit woke up and his bounce was gone. He tried a hop. {rabbit:wobble 0.3} Flop. Rabbit sat down in the grass, ears flat, and stayed there. Frog {frog:hop x3} came bounding over. Watch me, Rabbit! Hop, hop, hop! Now you! Rabbit tried. Flop. Frog stopped bounding. Bee {bee:float 0.7} zoomed in. Bzzz! Up you get! Bzzz-bzzz! Rabbit's ears did not move. Bee stopped zooming. Then they both sat down. One on each side of Rabbit. Nobody said anything. The sun was warm. Bee {bee:pulse 0.3} hummed, very softly, the way bees do. Mmmm. Frog {frog:pulse 0.3} hummed too, the way frogs do. Grrmm. The three of them sat, and hummed, and watched a cloud go by. After a while, one of Rabbit's ears went up. Then the other. Then, all by itself, {rabbit:hop} boing. Oh, said Rabbit. There it is. {rabbit:hearts} {frog:hearts} {bee:hearts} Thanks for waiting.

es-ES.title: Conejo pierde su salto
es-ES.text: Una mañana Conejo se despertó y su salto no estaba. Probó a saltar. {rabbit:wobble 0.3} Plof. Conejo se sentó en la hierba, con las orejas caídas, y allí se quedó. Rana {frog:hop x3} llegó a brincos. ¡Mírame, Conejo! ¡Salto, salto, salto! ¡Ahora tú! Conejo probó. Plof. Rana dejó de brincar. Abeja {bee:float 0.7} llegó zumbando. ¡Bzzz! ¡Arriba! ¡Bzzz-bzzz! Las orejas de Conejo no se movieron. Abeja dejó de zumbar. Y las dos se sentaron. Una a cada lado de Conejo. Nadie dijo nada. El sol calentaba. Abeja {bee:pulse 0.3} tarareó, muy bajito, como hacen las abejas. Mmmm. Rana {frog:pulse 0.3} tarareó también, como hacen las ranas. Grrmm. Los tres se quedaron sentados, tarareando, mirando pasar una nube. Al cabo de un rato, una oreja de Conejo se levantó. Luego la otra. Y luego, ella sola, {rabbit:hop} boing. Anda, dijo Conejo. Ahí está. {rabbit:hearts} {frog:hearts} {bee:hearts} Gracias por esperar.
